title: RuntimeExecutionReconcileRequest
description: HTTP/runtime request body for POST /v1/sessions/<session-id>/actions/<action-id>/claims/<lease-id>/reconcile. It closes an expired unresolved lease as outcome_unknown without creating a receipt.

reconciliation_id.description: Optional stable reconciliation id. When omitted or blank, the daemon derives reconcile-<lease-id>.

reconciled_by.description: Optional operator identity. When omitted or blank, the daemon uses the session creator.
